newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB to finance Tractebel buy mainly with loans-CEO.
newsitem.headline: SGB to finance Tractebel buy mainly with loans-CEO.

text.p: Belgian holding company Ste Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) is set to finance its 49 billion franc acquisition of a 24.47 percent stake in utility holding company Tractebel SA mainly with loans.

SGB chief executive officer Philippe Liotier told a news conference on Tuesday that SGB would have six billion francs of cash at its disposal after subscribing to a planned capital increase at its Generale Bank unit later this month.
He added that SGB had secured a syndicated credit for a total of 24 billion billion francs.
"That takes care of 30 billion francs in all. I am positive that we will get the rest of the necessary financing. Talks about it are already under way," he said.
SGB is buying the Tractebel stake from two affiliates of Belgian holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA (GBL), holding company Electrafina and insurer Royale Belge SA.
